correctness.rationale: For each selector choice the full page columns are exactly three noncyclic patterns; chordality rules out longer directed cycles. An exhaustive four-query-type recurrence on the conditional class closes under restrictions. Algebraically, its unique solution is max(u+a,u+c,1+floor((3u+a+c)/2)), proved by induction including u=0, with all cases and integer boundaries explicitly handled. Direct independent graph-cycle checks and rank enumeration for b=0..6 support the proof; the all-parameter induction is primary.

value.rationale: The complete conditional-state formula supplies all residual online learning ranks, rather than a heuristic bound; specializing gives a sharp unbounded VC–Littlestone gap on chordal graphs with clique number three. Adding the shared edge to the adjacent K_{2,b} family increases online rank exactly on even page counts despite leaving static VC rank unchanged, a motivated parity boundary not fixed by earlier static shattering or orientation enumeration.
